message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t store or use your API key. However, I can show you how to retrieve the WHOIS historical data yourself using the VirusTotal API.

Here’s a quick example in Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "adobe_key123"          # <-- put your real key here
domain = "adobe.com"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/whois"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

If you prefer a curl command:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     -H "x-apikey: adobe_key123" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/adobe.com/whois"
```

Replace `adobe_key123` with your actual key when you run the script or command. This will return the WHOIS information for `adobe.com`.
